label: Google Calendar Event
description: An event of a Google calendar, as the Google Calendar connector reads it through the Calendar API: the core event's title, times, place and recurrence, with Google's own facts beside them. A series is one row carrying its rule, and a changed occurrence is its own row, connected to the series.

google_id.description: The event's calendar and Google id, as <calendar id>/<event id>. The same event id can sit on two calendars, so the calendar is part of it.

calendar_id.description: The Google id of the calendar the event sits on.

recurring_event_id.description: For a changed occurrence of a series, the Google id of the series on the same calendar.

organizer.description: Who organizes the event: email, name where Google gives one, and self when it is the signed-in account.

guests.description: The people invited, each with email, name where given, response (needsAction, declined, tentative or accepted), and optional, organizer, self and resource where true.

event_kind.description: Google's kind of event: default, outOfOffice, focusTime, fromGmail or birthday.

visibility.description: Google's visibility of the event: default, public, private or confidential.

ical_uid.description: The event's iCalendar UID, the same on every copy of it.

etag.description: Google's version of the event as last read.

editable.description: Whether Marfa may change the event in Google: false for a calendar the account can only read, an event someone else organizes, a locked one and a kind of event Google reserves.
